title: Chicago Highlights Private Walking Tour with a Guide
includes: Private and exclusive tour, there won't be anyone else in your group.
Help from our team to book the tickets for the desired visits.
In person: English, Italian, French and Spanish speaking guide
Transportations (The cost of using public transport during the tour is at your own expense) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: It's a city tour and not a tour inside the monuments.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Immerse yourself in Chicago's architectural heritage on an exclusive walking tour, delving into the city's iconic structures and Art Deco gems. Begin your intimate journey by marveling at the grandeur of the Wrigley Building, followed by a step into the opulence of the Palmer House Hilton lobby. 
Admire the sleek lines of the Carbide and Carbon Building, a testament to Art Deco elegance, before appreciating the historic significance of the Reliance Building. Conclude your architectural odyssey with a visit to the exquisite Chicago Cultural Center, a masterpiece of design and culture. Throughout the tour, your knowledgeable guide illuminates Chicago's rich history and architectural evolution, weaving captivating stories that offer insight into the city's vibrant past and enduring legacy.
